title: Tenure Limits on Clean-Span Relief under Seller Performance Standing
content:
Long-standing sellers may have more points taken off by clean-span relief. The clean-span relief cap is the long-tenure cap of 8 points for a standing record opened 1,095 days or more before the handling date, and the mid-tenure cap of 6 points for a record opened at least 730 but fewer than 1,095 days before. A record opened fewer than 730 days before the handling date takes neither of these caps.

Tenure is read from the date the seller's Seller Performance Standing record was opened, counted in days to the handling date.

| Days from the opening of the standing record to the handling date | Clean-span relief cap |
|---|---|
| 1,095 or more | 8 points |
| 730 to 1,094 | 6 points |
| 729 or fewer | neither tenure cap |

## On each boundary (hypothetical records)

| Days since opening | Cap |
|---|---|
| 1,095 | 8 — exactly 1,095 days meets the long-tenure figure |
| 1,094 | 6 |
| 730 | 6 — exactly 730 days meets the mid-tenure figure |
| 729 | neither tenure cap |

**Worked figure.** For a record opened 800 days before the handling date, relief points of 7 are held at 6. For a record opened 1,200 days before, the same 7 points stand within the cap of 8.
